Nuestro equipo está conformado por profesionales de distintos campos, lo que nos permite ofrecer un enfoque integral y estratégico en cada proyecto. Como una marca joven y en rápido crecimiento, valoramos las nuevas ideas y fomentamos un entorno abierto donde todos pueden contribuir a dar forma al presente y al futuro de la empresa. Operamos en un estado constante de aprendizaje y evolución, siempre desafiando la manera en que hacemos las cosas hoy para mejorar mañana. Si te motiva trabajar en un entorno donde siempre hay espacio para innovar, probar y crecer, este es el lugar para vos. Responsabilidades Gestión de Proyectos y Operaciones: Supervisar y gestionar los proyectos de clientes, asegurando entregas puntuales y resultados de alta calidad. Colaborar con contratistas y miembros del equipo para promover un ambiente de trabajo productivo, desafiante y agradable. Actuar como principal punto de contacto para los clientes, asegurando que nuestras soluciones respondan a sus necesidades y generen valor tangible. Coordinar entre los distintos equipos (diseño, tecnología, estrategia) para asegurar una ejecución fluida de los proyectos. Planificar, organizar y dar seguimiento a las tareas, prioridades y plazos de cada proyecto. Implementar y perfeccionar sistemas y herramientas de gestión de proyectos para mejorar la eficiencia. Supervisar el progreso de los proyectos, identificar posibles obstáculos y proponer soluciones para garantizar el cumplimiento de los objetivos. Brindar apoyo en tareas operativas y colaborar en distintas áreas de la agencia cuando sea necesario, adaptándose a las necesidades de cada proyecto y del equipo. Perfil Buscado Bilingüe (excluyente) – Inglés avanzado, tanto oral como escrito; el idioma corporativo de la agencia es inglés. Mentalidad Proactiva – Te desenvolvés con soltura en entornos dinámicos, tomás la iniciativa y buscás constantemente maneras de mejorar los procesos y resultados. Versatilidad y Disposición para Aprender – Te interesa involucrarte en distintas áreas de la agencia, asumir nuevos desafíos y explorar herramientas y tecnologías emergentes, especialmente inteligencia artificial, para optimizar procesos y mejorar resultados. Orientación a Resultados – Tenés la capacidad de gestionar proyectos de principio a fin, asegurando el cumplimiento de objetivos, plazos y estándares de calidad. Excelente Comunicación – Gestionás relaciones con clientes y coordinás equipos multidisciplinarios de manera efectiva, asegurando claridad y alineación en cada proyecto. Capacidad Resolutiva – Pensás de manera crítica y proponés ideas innovadoras que impulsan la mejora continua. Organización y Atención al Detalle – Manejás múltiples proyectos de forma eficiente, manteniendo siempre altos estándares de calidad. No excluyente, pero ideal: Experiencia Internacional – Participación en intercambios, estudios en el extranjero o programas de Work and Travel. Experiencia en Agencias Fast-Paced – Haber trabajado en entornos de ritmo rápido donde la adaptabilidad y la eficiencia son clave. Conocimientos en Diseño y Desarrollo – Experiencia en diseño gráfico, UX/UI y/o desarrollo web será valorada. Conocimientos en Inteligencia Artificial – Familiaridad con herramientas de IA, automatizaciones y su aplicación en la gestión de proyectos y optimización de procesos será valorada. Compensación y Beneficios Paquete de Compensación: Salario base: USD $850/mes. Apoyo para comunicación: USD $50/mes. Beneficios: 15 días laborables de vacaciones pagadas al año. Feriados flexibles – Podés trabajar en un feriado y tomar otro día libre a cambio. Licencia por enfermedad – Tu salud es lo primero. Trabajá desde cualquier lugar – Mientras coordinemos horarios, podés trabajar desde donde quieras. Horarios flexibles – No medimos el trabajo por horas frente al escritorio, sino por la calidad de los resultados. Podés trabajar en los momentos en que seas más productivo(a), siempre que esto te permita colaborar con el equipo y responder a las necesidades de la empresa. Por Qué Unirte a Nosotros Contribuí a dar forma al futuro de una agencia joven y dinámica. Desarrollá tu trabajo en un entorno creativo y flexible, con libertad para experimentar y poner a prueba nuevas ideas. Sé parte de una empresa que valora la innovación, el crecimiento y el equilibrio entre la vida personal y laboral. Preferís postularte por mail? Para postularte, enviá tu cover letter y CV en inglés a andrea@joamagency.com. Asunto: [Tu nombre] - Project Manager

review_candidates.title: Project Management Officer EU-MicroNest - H/F
review_candidates.description: L’Inserm est le seul organisme public français entièrement dédié à la recherche biologique, médicale et en santé des populations. Il dispose de laboratoires de recherche sur l’ensemble du territoire, regroupés en 12 Délégations Régionales. Notre institut réunit 15 000 chercheurs, ingénieurs, techniciens et personnels administratifs, avec un objectif commun : améliorer la santé de tous par le progrès des connaissances sur le vivant et sur les maladies, l’innovation dans les traitements et la recherche en santé publique. Les cinq équipes de Recherche de ce laboratoire de Neurosciences travaillent sur la compréhension des mécanismes qui altèrent le fonctionnement du cerveau en développement depuis le fœtus jusqu’à l’adolescent, que les origines des dysfonctionnements soient génétiques ou environnementales (comme suite à une infection ou à un traumatisme physique par exemple) et que les maladies soient fréquentes ou ne touchent qu’un petit nombre de patients (maladies rares). Le Poste Mission principale Dans le cadre du projet européen MicroNest, nous recherchons un(e) Project Management Officer (PMO) afin d’accompagner la coordination scientifique et opérationnelle du projet. Sous la responsabilité de la coordination du projet, le/la PMO travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les équipes scientifiques, les partenaires du consortium et les services administratifs et financiers impliqués dans le projet. Il/elle assurera le pilotage opérationnel, la structuration et le suivi des activités du projet , en veillant au respect du plan de travail, des échéances, des livrables et des obligations contractuelles. Il/elle contribuera également à l’animation du consortium, au reporting et à la circulation de l’information entre les différents partenaires. Activités principales Appui au pilotage et à la coordination générale du projet MicroNest, en lien avec la coordination scientifique et les partenaires du consortium. Suivi du plan de travail, des échéances, livrables et jalons du projet et mise à jour des outils de pilotage (tableaux de bord, indicateurs, planning, registre des risques). Animation du consortium : organisation des réunions, préparation des ordres du jour et comptes rendus, suivi des décisions et plans d’actions et circulation de l’information entre partenaires. Suivi opérationnel des Work Packages : collecte et consolidation des informations auprès des responsables de WP et suivi de l’avancement des activités. Contribution au suivi administratif, contractuel et financier du projet en lien avec les services compétents et les partenaires. Contribution au reporting et à la préparation des livrables et rapports du projet, notamment dans le cadre des obligations liées au financement européen. Spécificité(s) et environnement du poste Travail dans un environnement scientifique international et multidisciplinaire. Interactions régulières avec les partenaires académiques et institutionnels du consortium. Participation aux réunions de coordination et aux instances de gouvernance du projet. Utilisation quotidienne de l’anglais écrit et oral. Interactions avec les services administratifs, financiers et de valorisation impliqués dans la gestion du projet. Déplacements ponctuels possibles en France et en Europe dans le cadre des réunions du consortium. Profil Recherché Connaissances Maîtrise de l’environnement de la recherche académique et biomédicale. Maîtrise de la gestion de projets de recherche collaboratifs. Connaissance des mécanismes de financement et de suivi des projets européens. Maîtrise des principes de gouvernance des consortiums scientifiques. Excellente compréhension des enjeux scientifiques et organisationnels liés aux projets de recherche. Maîtrise de l’anglais professionnel et scientifique, écrit et oral. Savoir-faire Maîtriser les méthodes et outils de gestion et de suivi de projet. Construire et mettre à jour des outils de pilotage : planning, tableaux de bord, indicateurs, suivi des livrables et jalons. Coordonner des activités impliquant de multiples interlocuteurs et partenaires. Organiser et animer des réunions de projet et assurer le suivi des décisions. Collecter, synthétiser et consolider des informations scientifiques, administratives et financières. Rédiger des documents de synthèse, comptes rendus, rapports et supports de présentation. Identifier les risques et points de blocage et contribuer à la mise en place d’actions correctives. Communiquer efficacement en français et en anglais avec des interlocuteurs scientifiques et administratifs. Aptitudes Rigueur et sens de l’organisation. Autonomie et capacité d’initiative. Excellentes capacités relationnelles et de communication. Capacité à travailler en équipe et dans un environnement multidisciplinaire. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs activités en parallèle et à respecter les échéances. Esprit d’analyse et de synthèse. Adaptabilité et réactivité. Une expérience en coordination ou gestion de projets de recherche collaboratifs, idéalement dans un environnement académique, biomédical et/ou européen, serait appréciée. Une expérience de travail au sein de consortiums multidisciplinaires et internationaux constitue un atout.

review_candidates.title: Product Marketing Manager
review_candidates.description: About HB Antwerp HB Antwerp isn’t your typical company. We’re trailblazers, revolutionizing the journey of natural diamonds—from their raw form all the way to the customer. We believe that minerals, like diamonds, belong to their country of origin, and we’ve developed a fair business model to ensure miners and governments have complete transparency on the value of their resources post-production. Based in Antwerp, a city famed for its artistry and craftsmanship, we blend creativity with cutting-edge technology to push the legacy of diamond expertise into the future. Every diamond we work with is ethically sourced and transformed in-house, with each step verified through our innovative digital ecosystem. This isn’t just diamond craftsmanship; it’s a movement. About the role As Product Marketing Manager within our Sales & Marketing team, you will be the owner and driving force behind our premium product: exceptionally rare natural diamonds, shaped by master craftsmanship and backed by uncompromising provenance. You own how it is positioned, brought to market and grown internationally, and you are accountable for its commercial success. We’re deliberately looking beyond the diamond industry. We’re looking for someone who will change how the world sees it. You’ve built premium products that people desire, defend and are willing to pay for, and you’re ready to do it again with one of the rarest products on earth. Your Responsibilities Take full ownership of our premium product and be its driving force, internally and in the market. Define and sharpen its positioning, value proposition and story, and make sure it stands out in the international luxury market. Build and drive the go-to-market strategy and product marketing roadmap, with clear priorities, targets and timelines. Lead launches and integrated campaigns across digital and offline channels, and own every touchpoint along the way. Manage your projects, budget and external partners (agencies, photographers, event partners) with clear accountability for results. Set KPIs, track commercial and marketing performance, and report results and next steps to management.   What you bring 10+ years of marketing experience, at least 5 of them in product marketing at a brand that’s recognised for marketing excellence in premium tech, luxury, fashion, design or automotive. A product you’ve taken to the next level: you’ve owned a premium product or product line end to end, from positioning to launch to growth, and you can show the commercial results. International launches under your belt: you’ve brought products to market across several countries and know how to keep a brand consistent while adapting to each market. A strong storyteller with an eye for design: you turn what makes a product special into a story people remember, and you care about how it looks, sounds and feels at every touchpoint. Hands-on, digitally fluent and structured: you set the strategy, are just as comfortable making it happen yourself, and steer agencies, budgets and partners with confidence. A fresh pair of eyes: no diamond experience needed. We’re looking for someone who’ll see our world differently. Fluent in English; other languages are a plus. Who you are Product-obsessed: You know the product better than anyone and care about every detail of how it’s presented. An owner: You don’t wait for a brief. You set the direction and take responsibility for the results. Collaborative Leader: You build strong relationships with Sales, leadership, our craftsmen and external partners. What’s in it for you? A key role with real ownership over a truly exceptional product. A competitive salary and benefits package that reflects your experience. The chance to work with some of the world’s rarest diamonds and the master craftsmen who shape them. A vibrant, creative workspace in the heart of Antwerp. How to Apply Ready to take the next step in your career? Upload your CV and a cover letter telling us about a product you’ve taken to the next level, and what excites you about this role via our website: https://hbantwerp.com/vacancies/vacancy-product-marketing-manager/. We look forward to meeting our next Product Marketing Manager.

review_candidates.title: Marketing Assistant
review_candidates.description: Fastmarkets is an industry-leading price-reporting agency (PRA) and information provider for global commodities, providing price data, news, analytics and events for the agriculture, forest products, metals and mining and new-generation energy markets. Fastmarkets' data is critical for customers seeking to understand and predict dynamic, sometimes opaque markets, enabling trading and risk management. Fastmarkets is a global business with a history dating back to 1865 and is built on trust and deep market knowledge. It has more than 700 employees spread across global locations in the UK, US, China, India, Singapore, Brazil, Belgium, Bulgaria, Finland and beyond. Job Description The Role The Marketing Assistant provides campaign execution and operational support to a Marketing Manager across the Fastmarkets Events portfolio. The role supports the delivery of integrated marketing campaigns designed to grow audience reach, engagement and delegate bookings. Working closely with the Marketing Manager, the Marketing Assistant coordinates day-to-day campaign activity across channels, supports marketing communications and content delivery, maintains accurate campaign and audience data, and tracks performance against agreed objectives. Using campaign results and audience insights, the role helps identify opportunities to improve targeting, engagement and conversion. Principal Accountabilities Campaign execution Execute community marketing campaigns – across delegate, speaker and exhibitor/sponsor groups – to improve reach and grow delegate bookings. Execute email marketing campaigns for the assigned Fastmarkets events. Conduct media partner outreach and fulfil agreed partnership commitments, ensuring activity is delivered effectively to support delegate acquisition. Update and optimise event websites with fresh, relevant content that strengthens event positioning and encourages delegate bookings. Support the delivery of promotional activity across social media, PR and other relevant channels, including creating and scheduling content. Operational support Maintain and update competitor research. Coordinate audience research and data updates, supporting data sourcing where required. Maintain event campaign reporting, including quick access to registration and email performance reports. Produce ad hoc data and campaign reports to support the Marketing Manager’s analysis. KEY INTERFACES Marketing Manager, Events (line manager) Event marketing team External suppliers (Gleanin; Datamatics) Delegate and SPEX sales teams Customer services team Media partners QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE: Experience: 1 – 2 years’ work experience in an office environment (including virtual) would be preferable but this role could suit a bright, self-motivated person who is looking for their first step on the career ladder Education: Educated to degree level, preferably in marketing, business or languages. Qualifications We recruit talented, dynamic people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, all united by a belief in our mission to provide the world’s leading and most trusted price reporting, events, and intelligence service for the markets we serve. We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to creating a fully inclusive workplace, where everyone feels able to participate and contribute meaningfully. If you are open-minded, curious, resilient, solutions-oriented and committed to promoting equality, then read on. KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS We are looking for an individual who is highly motivated, driven, and has a passion to be part of a fast-paced, successful team. Being a strong team player who works closely with a Marketing Manager is also important as well as being happy to work flexibly. Fluent in English & Bulgarian Self-motivated and goal-focused Deadline-driven Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise Razor-sharp attention to detail Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal Confident and personable Computer literate (Excel & Word as standard – full training will be given on our other software systems) Knowledge and experience working with AI platforms (a plus) If you're excited about the role but your experience, skills or qualifications don't perfectly align, we encourage you to apply anyway. Additional Information Our Values Fastmarkets people come from all different walks of life. It’s this mix of brilliant personalities, experiences and insights that gives us that warm, open, and friendly culture you can feel as soon as you meet us. But however wonderfully different we all are, there are six things we all have in common – and they form our Fastmarkets values. Created by our own employees to reflect some of the personal traits that Fastmarkets people have, our values are key to what makes our culture unique. They reflect who each of us are and they're embedded in everything we do. Our values are: METRICS DRIVEN. We use insights to improve our customers’ experience and our business performance ACCOUNTABLE. We are accountable to ourselves and those we work with: we keep our promises and get things done GROWTH MINDSET . This value enables us to be nimble to the changing realities and operate with a sense of urgency INCLUSIVE. We are inclusive and respectful, celebrating each of us and giving everyone a deep sense of belonging with the desire to bring their best self to work every day. CUSTOMER CENTRIC. We are customer-centric in all that we do COLLABORATIVE. We are collaborative, able to work across teams and capitalise on the diversity of intellect, perspectives, and experiences. We are committed to ensuring all candidates feel welcomed and supported. Should your application advance and you require accommodations for the interview process, please inform us so we can make the necessary arrangements. Reward and benefits at Fastmarkets We believe in fair pay and benefits that support you both inside and outside of work. Through Fastmarkets Rewards, you'll have access to a range of core benefits and a flexible allowance, giving you the freedom to tailor your package to suit your lifestyle, wellbeing and financial priorities. We know that everyone's needs are different, so we've designed our benefits to support our diverse global team wherever they're based. Specific benefits may vary by country and role. You’ve read a little about us – now it’s over to you! If you like what you’ve read so far and think you can see yourself as a Fastmarkets person, it’s time to fill in your application form. This form is an important part of the selection process: it’s used to determine whether or not you’ll be chosen to have an interview and acts as a basis for the questions we’ll ask you on the day. It’s vital that you try to capture all the relevant information we have asked for on the form so we can get a good feel for who you are and why you’re great.

The role involves coordinating deliveries and transportation, maintaining accurate inventory and logistics records, monitoring the condition and availability of received goods, and ensuring that supplies are delivered to the relevant schools and departments in accordance with operational requirements. The Logistics Officer works closely with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and service providers to resolve logistical issues, maintain service quality, and support the smooth and effective operation of procurement and logistics activities. Areas of responsibility: Receive and review purchase orders, coordinate with suppliers and internal departments, and ensure the accuracy and completeness of all required information and supporting documentation. Demonstrate advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data management, analysis, advanced formulas and functions, Pivot Tables, and the preparation of procurement reports. Utilize Microsoft Power BI to integrate procurement data from multiple sources and systems, develop interactive dashboards. Support the management of supplier relationships, monitor compliance with quality standards and delivery requirements, communicate with suppliers regarding order status, resolve issues and disputes, and maintain accurate and updated supplier records. Prepare and maintain accurate and up-to-date records of receiving status, tracking and scheduling pending deliveries, following up on outstanding deliveries and uploading receiving documentation. Ensure all procurement activities comply with Misk Schools' approved procurement policies and procedures, as well as applicable laws and regulations. Work collaboratively with colleagues across departments, promote effective communication, and contribute to achieving organizational objectives. Understand and prioritize the needs and expectations of internal and external stakeholders, ensuring efficient and professional service delivery in accordance with approved policies and procedures. Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability in responding to changing business requirements, managing priorities, and supporting the organization's operational needs. Contribute to the continuous improvement of procurement systems, processes, and procedures by identifying opportunities for automation, streamlining workflows, enhancing operational efficiency, and reducing manual activities. Maintain, organize, and archive historical procurement records and supporting documentation, ensuring accuracy, accessibility, and compliance with audit and record retention requirements. Undertake additional duties as and when required by the line manager. Safeguarding: The post holder will be required to safeguard and promote the welfare of children and young people and follow the school’s safeguarding policies and the staff code of conduct. They will directly support the designated safeguarding lead as a priority to ensure the safety and wellbeing of all students at the school. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in business, supply chain management, procurement, or any related field (essential). Experience: 2+ years of relevant experience. Skills, Knowledge and Abilities: Ability to Analyze Data. Ability to communicate clearly in written and spoken English and Arabic with colleagues and external agencies. Time Management skills. Communication skills. Problem-solving skills. Analytical skills. Attention to details. Strong organizational skills. Familiarity with procurement software. Ability to work independently.

You will collaborate with stakeholders across H&M Group and engage regularly with venture capital firms, entrepreneurs, advisors, and other external partners. The role offers broad exposure to both strategic initiatives and the wider innovation ecosystem, giving you a unique opportunity to build a strong network across industries and markets. WHO YOU ARE You are a curious, social, analytical, and commercially minded professional with a genuine passion for investing, innovation, and entrepreneurship. You are just as comfortable working through a set of financial statements as you are walking into a room full of new people. You enjoy meeting founders, starting conversations, and following up on them, and you see every event as a chance to discover the next great company to invest in. You are a proactive self-starter who builds trust through collaboration and clear communication. You will succeed in this role if you have: A degree in finance, economics, business, engineering, or a related field 2+years of experience from venture capital, private equity, investment banking, transaction services, management consulting, or a similar analytical role Solid experience in financial analysis, including modeling and valuation Experience conducting market research, commercial assessments, and due diligence A natural ability to network, build relationships, and generate new leads Energy and enthusiasm for representing the team at external events, including meetups and gatherings across the world Excellent communication and presentation skills The ability to manage multiple workstreams and priorities at the same time Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint Fluency in English, both written and spoken WHO WE ARE H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. Read more about us here. JOIN US Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things — our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. With approximately 80% of the role focused on planning and advisory , this position is suited to a technically strong tax professional who enjoys solving complex problems, identifying opportunities and building trusted client relationships. You'll work closely with Partners, lead engagement teams and help clients navigate increasingly complex international tax considerations, with the autonomy to make a meaningful contribution to both client outcomes and the wider practice. The opportunity Lead international tax planning — develop cross-border tax strategies, evaluate entity structures and identify opportunities to improve tax efficiency for multinational clients. Own complex engagements — oversee projects from initial analysis through implementation, ensuring technical quality, commercial relevance and timely delivery. Drive technical excellence — guide international tax calculations, review complex filings and advise on issues involving GILTI, Subpart F, FDII, BEAT and foreign tax credit optimization. Become a trusted adviser — work directly with clients and senior stakeholders, translating complex tax matters into clear, commercially focused recommendations. Influence and develop your team — provide technical direction, delegate effectively, mentor developing professionals and maintain high standards across client deliverables. Work across jurisdictions — coordinate with overseas advisers and international professional networks on multi-jurisdictional matters. Contribute to growth — support proposals, scope new engagements and help identify opportunities to expand client relationships. Compliance remains an important part of the position, including the review of complex US federal, state and international tax returns, but the emphasis is firmly on strategic planning, consulting and advisory work . What we're looking for This is a specialist appointment, and relevant technical depth is essential. 7+ years of public accounting experience , with substantial exposure to international taxation. Active CPA or EA credential. Bachelor's or master's degree in Accounting. Demonstrable experience advising on international tax planning, cross-border structures and complex multinational tax matters. Strong technical knowledge of international tax provisions, ideally including GILTI, Subpart F, foreign tax credits and related planning considerations. Experience reviewing complex tax work, managing engagements and providing guidance to other professionals. Confidence communicating technical recommendations directly to clients and senior stakeholders. A broad domestic tax background alone is unlikely to be sufficient. We're particularly interested in professionals who can demonstrate meaningful international tax planning and consulting experience , rather than compliance experience alone. What's on offer? $130,000–$165,000 base salary , dependent on experience and location. Fully remote working arrangement. A planning-led position with an approximate 80/20 split between advisory and compliance. Direct exposure to Partners and complex, multinational client engagements. Opportunities to develop client relationships, mentor colleagues and contribute to business growth. Benefits package including medical, dental and vision coverage, retirement plan contributions, paid time off and professional development support. Interested in taking the next step? If your experience combines strong international tax technical knowledge with a genuine interest in planning and advisory work, this could be an excellent opportunity to take your career forward. Apply here to discuss the opportunity confidentially.
